title: Entity Ignore Cannot Be Attacked
description: Allows the owner entity to ignore the "minecraft:cannot_be_attacked" component on entities that fulfill the filter.

domain.title: Domain
domain.description: The domain the test should be performed in.

subject.title: Subject
subject.description: The subject of this filter test.

test.title: Test
test.description: The name of the test to apply.

value.title: Value
value.description: The value being compared with the test.

filters.title: Filters
filters.description: Defines which entities are exceptions and are allowed to be attacked by the owner entity, potentially attacked entity is subject "other". If this is not specified then all attacks by the owner are allowed.
